head.i: Acquisitio per servos usufructuar. b. fide possessos &c

main_text.p: 4. §. {a}Quomodo acquirimus per usufru-ctuarios, servos, bona fide possessos homines liberos bona fide servientes?De iis autem servis, in quib. tantummodo usufructum habetis, ita placuit: ut quidquid ex re vestra, v[illegible, ~2 letters] ex operis suis adquirant, id vobis adjiciatur: quod ve[illegible, ~2 letters] extra eas causas consequuti sunt, id ad dominum propr[illegible, ~2 letters]tatis pertineat. Itaque si is servus haeres institutus sit, le[illegible, ~3 letters]tumve quid ei, aut donatum fuerit: non usufructuar[illegible, ~2 letters] sed domino proprietatis adquiritur. idem placet & de e[illegible, ~1 letter] qui a vobis bona fide possidetur: sive is liber sit, sive a[illegible, ~3 letters]nus servus. Quod enim placuit de usufructuario, idem pla[illegible, ~1 letter]cet & de bonae fidei possessore. Itaque quod extra duas causas adquiritur: id vel ad ipsum pertinet, sive[?] liber est: vel ad dominum si servus est. Sed bonae fidei posse[illegible, ~3 letters] cum usuceperit servum, (quia eo modo dominus fit) omnibus causis per eum sibi adquirere potest. Fruc[illegible, ~3 letters]rius vero usucapere non potest: primum, quia non po[illegible, ~4 letters]det, sed habet jus utendi fruendi: deinde quia scit serv[illegible, ~2 letters] alienum esse. Non solum autem proprietas per eos vos, in quibus, usumfructum habetis, vel quos bona possidetis, aut per liberam personam, quae bona fide bis[?] servit, vobis adquiritur: sed etiam possessio. Lo[illegible, ~3 letters]mur autem in utriusque persona secundum distinctione[illegible, ~1 letter] quam proxime expofuimus: id est, si quam possessionem [illegible, ~2 letters] re vestra, vel ex suis operis adepti fuerint.

Quarto in §. 4. {b}n agit de servis fructuariis, & de serv[illegible, ~3 letters]lienis, aut hominibus liberis bona fide possessis, ac duas quae[illegible, ~3 letters]ues dissolvit. Prima quaestio est, quibus ex causis acquirant [illegible, ~3 letters]ctuario, vel bonae fidei possessori. Hic notatur similitudo, & [illegible, ~4 letters]ferentia fructuarii, & bona fide possessi. Similitudo est, quod[?] has personas acquirimus tantum ex re nostra, & ex operis i[illegible, ~3 letters]rum (quamquam si ex his causis servus fructuarius proprieta[illegible, ~3 letters] stipuletur, ipsi proprietario acquirit; sed fructuarius ei conc[illegible, ~3 letters]re potest. D. de stipulat. servor. l. penult. Ex aliis vero causis servi sunt acquirunt dominis proprietatis; si vero sunt hono[illegible, ~3 letters] liberi a nobis bona fide possessi, acquirunt sibi ipsis: nisi qui[illegible, ~1 letter] relictum sit contemplatione fructuarii, vel bonae fidei possi[illegible, ~3 letters].

page.notes: The right side of the page is partly covered by the facing page, so the last letters of many lines are missing. These are marked as illegible, not guessed. "possideri," at the top is a fragment that continues from the previous page. "sive[?] liber est": the scan reads "fili" here, which is doubtful; the word is cut at the gutter. "bis[?] servit": the word at the start of the line is doubtful; the line may have been cut. "quod[?]" and "usu[...]" in the top paragraph are doubtful readings. "{b}n": the mark "b" is followed by a small "n", which may be a second reference mark. No note b appears in the margin of this page. The heading contains "b." as a reference mark with no matching note on this page. Printed long s (s) has been transcribed as s; "fit" printed for "sit" has been corrected to "sit" in the relevant places. "Loquimur" is partly hidden at the gutter; the reading is inferred from the visible letters.
